sentences.en: And then in 2010, he got his dream job, working at Google.
sentences.zh: 然后在 2010 年，他得到了梦寐以求的工作，进入了谷歌。

sentences.en: And so when I joined Google, I actually didn't know which project I would be put on.
sentences.zh: 所以当我加入谷歌时，我其实不知道会被分配到哪个项目。

sentences.en: And when he gets to Google, he gets this really interesting and exciting assignment.
sentences.zh: 当他来到谷歌时，他接到了一个非常有趣且令人兴奋的任务。

sentences.en: Yeah, it turned out that he needed someone on the AI of YouTube, so it was a perfect fit.
sentences.zh: 是的，结果他们需要有人负责 YouTube 的人工智能，所以这非常合适。

sentences.en: And the project he's assigned to work on is ultimately what distinguishes YouTube from every other website on the Internet.
sentences.zh: 他被分配到的项目最终使 YouTube 区别于互联网上的所有其他网站。

sentences.en: And that has to do with the recommendations sidebar and the artificial intelligence that makes the whole thing work.
sentences.zh: 这与推荐侧边栏以及使整个系统运作的人工智能有关。

sentences.en: And did this seem to you like a big deal to be given a job at Google working on YouTube recommendations?
sentences.zh: 被分配到谷歌负责 YouTube 推荐工作，这对你来说是一件大事吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that was really amazing at first to realize that my work was going to be affecting so many people.
sentences.zh: 是的，起初意识到我的工作将影响这么多人，真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: So I thought it was going to be a good thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一件好事。

sentences.en: I thought, okay, we can make artificial intelligence to make the world a better place.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，我们可以利用人工智能让世界变得更美好。

sentences.en: And when you got there, I assume there was some algorithm that was selecting videos for people.
sentences.zh: 当你到那里时，我想应该有一种算法在为人们选择视频。

sentences.en: How did that algorithm work?
sentences.zh: 那个算法是如何工作的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so initially when YouTube started, what's best was like clicks.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以最初 YouTube 刚开始时，最好的指标是点击量。

sentences.en: Like the more people clicked on videos, the better they thought it was.
sentences.zh: 点击视频的人越多，他们就认为视频越好。

sentences.en: And then they realized that it led to too many clickbaits.
sentences.zh: 后来他们意识到这导致了太多的标题党。

sentences.en: So people would click on the title, then realize that the video was not at all about what was said in the title.
sentences.zh: 人们点击标题，然后发现视频内容根本不是标题所说的那样。

sentences.en: And then they would leave the platform immediately.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会立即离开平台。

sentences.en: So that would be actually bad for YouTube.
sentences.zh: 所以这对 YouTube 来说其实很糟糕。

sentences.en: So then they switched their measure to total watch time.
sentences.zh: 于是他们把衡量标准改成了总观看时长。

sentences.en: And how was the goal of this algorithm explained to you?
sentences.zh: 这个算法的目标是如何向你解释的？

sentences.en: Like what did you understand about what YouTube's executives wanted?
sentences.zh: 你对 YouTube 高管想要什么有什么了解？

sentences.en: The idea was to maximize watch time at all costs to just make it grow as big as possible.
sentences.zh: 想法是不惜一切代价最大化观看时长，让它尽可能地增长。

sentences.en: It seems like a simple shift, but that shift has radical consequences.
sentences.zh: 这看起来是一个简单的转变，但这个转变产生了根本性的后果。

sentences.en: YouTube's watch time has gone up by 50%.
sentences.zh: YouTube 的观看时长增长了 50%。

sentences.en: I'm seeing accelerating usage growth.
sentences.zh: 我看到使用量在加速增长。

sentences.en: It produces these numbers that no one has ever seen before.
sentences.zh: 它创造了前所未有的数字。

sentences.en: YouTube now pulls in more than a billion dollars a quarter.
sentences.zh: YouTube 现在每季度收入超过十亿美元。

sentences.en: So it's an incredible size of audience who are consuming ever more video content.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个庞大的受众群体，他们正在消费越来越多的视频内容。

sentences.en: It's not so much if you're watching YouTube, it's how much.
sentences.zh: 重要的不是你是否在看 YouTube，而是看了多少。

sentences.en: How are you feeling about your work at this point?
sentences.zh: 你现在对你在谷歌的工作感觉如何？

sentences.en: I think we were so excited on working on this project that we didn't really question too much that watch time was a good metric.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时对这个项目太兴奋了，以至于没有真正质疑观看时长是否是一个好的指标。

sentences.en: We were thinking, yeah, I mean, if people are watching longer, they might be happier about what they're watching.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，嗯，如果人们看得更久，他们可能会对所看的内容更满意。

sentences.en: So at the time, I felt pretty good about this.
sentences.zh: 所以当时，我对这个感觉还不错。

sentences.en: If I had a moment to stick earbuds in my ear, to reject how we are viewed by others, any single moment that I wasn't talking to someone, I was consuming content.
sentences.zh: 如果我有时间戴上耳机，拒绝他人对我的看法，只要我没在和人说话，我就会在消费内容。

sentences.en: Hey, everybody.
sentences.zh: 嘿，大家好。

sentences.en: This episode of the podcast is brought to you by...
sentences.zh: 本期播客由……赞助播出。

sentences.en: But then I realized there were some issues.
sentences.zh: 但后来我意识到了一些问题。

sentences.en: People were noticing that you had a problem with maximizing just watch time that it creates these filter bubbles.
sentences.zh: 人们注意到，仅仅最大化观看时长会产生问题，它会制造这些过滤气泡。

sentences.en: Say more about that.
sentences.zh: 多说说这个。

sentences.en: The way I explained it when I was at YouTube at the time was...
sentences.zh: 我在 YouTube 工作时是这样解释的……

sentences.en: Say hi to everybody.
sentences.zh: 和大家打个招呼。

sentences.en: When you watch a cat video, then the recommendation engine can say, oh, you watch the cat video, so we are going to give you another cat video.
sentences.zh: 当你看了猫咪视频，推荐引擎就会说，哦，你看了猫咪视频，那我们再给你推荐一个猫咪视频。

sentences.en: And then another cat video.
sentences.zh: 然后是另一个猫咪视频。

sentences.en: And then another cat video.
sentences.zh: 然后又是另一个猫咪视频。

sentences.en: More of the same.
sentences.zh: 更多同样的内容。

sentences.en: More of the same.
sentences.zh: 更多同样的内容。

sentences.en: More of the same.
sentences.zh: 更多同样的内容。

sentences.en: At the time, I was really worried about wasting human potential.
sentences.zh: 当时，我真的很担心浪费人类的潜能。

sentences.en: If you could go on all of YouTube, but then the thing that's going to keep you watching the most is cats.
sentences.zh: 如果你可以看 YouTube 上的所有内容，但最能让你一直看下去的东西却是猫。

sentences.en: Is it the right thing to do to give you, again, cats on cats on cats?
sentences.zh: 一直给你推荐猫、猫、猫，这样做对吗？

sentences.en: And over time, Guillaume realizes that this filter bubble problem he's been noticing, it's actually worse than everyone just watching the same cat videos over and over.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，纪尧姆意识到他注意到的这个过滤气泡问题，实际上比每个人反复看同样的猫咪视频要糟糕得多。

sentences.en: So at the time, it was a demonstration in Cairo.
sentences.zh: 当时，开罗正在发生示威游行。

sentences.en: In Cairo, Egypt?
sentences.zh: 在埃及开罗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Violence has erupted in the Egyptian capital Cairo as though...
sentences.zh: 埃及首都开罗爆发了暴力冲突，因为……

sentences.en: He sees these news videos, these political videos, like this conflict in Egypt that's going on at the time.
sentences.zh: 他看到了这些新闻视频、政治视频，比如当时正在发生的埃及冲突。

sentences.en: And he sees that the algorithm is showing people in different groups the same thing over and over.
sentences.zh: 他发现算法在向不同群体的人反复展示同样的东西。

sentences.en: And you would see a video from the side of the protesters, and then it would recommend another video from the side of protesters.
sentences.zh: 你会看到一个抗议者方的视频，然后它会推荐另一个抗议者方的视频。

sentences.en: So you would only see the side of protesters.
sentences.zh: 所以你只能看到抗议者的一面。

sentences.en: You start with the side of the police, you would only see the side of the police.
sentences.zh: 如果你从警察的一面开始，你就只能看到警察的一面。

sentences.en: And you had only one side of reality, you couldn't see both sides.
sentences.zh: 你只能看到现实的一面，无法看到两面。

sentences.en: So these two different realities were created.
sentences.zh: 于是这两种不同的现实被创造了出来。

sentences.en: Once you recognized that there were these filter bubbles, these sort of algorithmic echo chambers, what did you do about it?
sentences.zh: 当你意识到存在这些过滤气泡，这些算法回声室时，你做了什么？

sentences.en: So the first thing I didn't want to do is complain about it and try to find like the bad example that shows what's wrong with it.
sentences.zh: 我不想做的第一件事就是抱怨，试图找出坏例子来证明它有什么问题。

sentences.en: Because I didn't want to be the grumpy French guy who complains.
sentences.zh: 因为我不想成为那个爱抱怨的刻薄法国人。

sentences.en: So what I did is side projects.
sentences.zh: 所以我做的是副业项目。

sentences.en: Like I created with another engineer who's still at YouTube.
sentences.zh: 比如我和另一位仍在 YouTube 工作的工程师一起创建了……

sentences.en: We created an algorithm that did the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 我们创建了一个完全相反的算法。

sentences.en: It got out of the filter bubble.
sentences.zh: 它能跳出过滤气泡。

sentences.en: And did any of these side projects have any impact at YouTube?
sentences.zh: 这些副业项目对 YouTube 有什么影响吗？

sentences.en: Like did they move into testing?
sentences.zh: 比如它们进入测试阶段了吗？

sentences.en: Were they implemented?
sentences.zh: 它们被实施了吗？

sentences.en: Did managers like them?
sentences.zh: 经理们喜欢它们吗？

sentences.en: No, they were always just prototype.
sentences.zh: 不，它们一直只是原型。

sentences.en: But then they were never even test on real users.
sentences.zh: 而且它们甚至从未在真实用户身上测试过。

sentences.en: And why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: I mean, the way they were saying it is that, okay, it's not our objective.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们当时的说法是，好吧，这不是我们的目标。

sentences.en: And our objective was to increase watch time.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是增加观看时长。

sentences.en: So the problem of sort of political polarization of giving people only one side of a story, like you're noticing this problem while you're at YouTube.
sentences.zh: 所以政治极化的问题，只给人们看故事的一面，你在 YouTube 工作时就注意到了这个问题。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you were trying to address it through these side projects.
sentences.zh: 听起来你试图通过这些副业项目来解决它。

sentences.en: But, you know, your bosses are not saying, Guillaume, that's the best idea we've ever heard.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，你的老板并没有说，纪尧姆，这是我们听过最好的主意。

sentences.en: Let's put it live on the site right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在就把它发布到网站上吧。

sentences.en: Like, how did things unfold for you at YouTube from there?
sentences.zh: 那么，从那以后你在 YouTube 的经历是怎样的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so when I proposed the third project to my manager, he told me if I were you, I wouldn't work on it too much.
sentences.zh: 是啊，当我向经理提议第三个项目时，他告诉我，如果我是你，我就不会花太多精力在上面。

sentences.en: And then for a few months, I didn't work on it.
sentences.zh: 于是有几个月的时间，我没再碰那个项目。

sentences.en: And then when I started working on it again, then I got fired for bad performance review.
sentences.zh: 后来当我重新开始做那个项目时，我就因为绩效评估不佳被解雇了。

sentences.en: Which is true because then I spent so much time on this project that I spent less time on my main project.
sentences.zh: 这确实是真的，因为我把太多时间花在了这个项目上，导致我没时间做我的主线项目。

sentences.en: So Guillaume left Google, actually left Silicon Valley altogether and moved back to France.
sentences.zh: 所以纪尧姆离开了谷歌，实际上是彻底离开了硅谷，搬回了法国。

sentences.en: And he says that he kind of stopped thinking about the YouTube algorithm altogether until one day, like an old French romance, the two meet again.
sentences.zh: 他说他几乎不再去想 YouTube 算法的事了，直到有一天，就像一段古老的法国浪漫史，两人再次相遇。

sentences.en: I was in a bus ride from Lyon to Paris.
sentences.zh: 当时我正坐巴士从里昂去巴黎。

sentences.en: So it was a six-hour bus ride.
sentences.zh: 那是一趟六小时的车程。

sentences.en: I was working in Paris, but I had family in Lyon.
sentences.zh: 我在巴黎工作，但我的家人在里昂。

sentences.en: So I was visiting my family and then coming back to work in Paris.
sentences.zh: 所以我去探望家人，然后回巴黎工作。

sentences.en: And there were these new buses with Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 当时车上配备了新的 Wi-Fi。

sentences.en: So I thought, OK, let's give it a try.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，好吧，试一试吧。

sentences.en: So he's sitting there on the bus.
sentences.zh: 于是他坐在巴士上。

sentences.en: He's on his laptop.
sentences.zh: 他正用着笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: He's doing some work.
sentences.zh: 他在处理一些工作。

sentences.en: And he notices that on the screen next to him, my neighbor was watching YouTube videos for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 他注意到旁边屏幕上，我的邻座看了很长时间的 YouTube 视频。

sentences.en: The guy was just going from one recommended video to the next recommended video to the next, to the next, to the next, to the next.
sentences.zh: 那个人只是从一个推荐视频点到下一个，再下一个，再下一个，没完没了。

sentences.en: Part of me was pretty proud that, well, I worked on this algorithm, so I helped him watch so much content.
sentences.zh: 我心里有一部分挺自豪的，毕竟我参与了算法开发，所以我帮他看了这么多内容。

sentences.en: And I was kind of curious which recommendations were so good that he was so captivated by YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我也很好奇，到底是什么样的推荐内容让他如此沉迷于 YouTube。

sentences.en: And then I saw that he was watching conspiracy theories about a secret plan to kill two billion people.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到他在看关于“杀掉二十亿人的秘密计划”的阴谋论视频。

sentences.en: So naturally, I tried to make a joke with him, oh, who wants to kill us, to try to initiate a conversation.
sentences.zh: 于是我很自然地想跟他开个玩笑，说“谁想杀我们啊”，试图开启一段对话。

sentences.en: And he told me, oh, there is this secret plan.
sentences.zh: 他却告诉我，噢，确实有这个秘密计划。

sentences.en: Look at it because medias are not going to tell you about it.
sentences.zh: 去看看吧，因为媒体是不会告诉你的。

sentences.en: But if you look on YouTube, you'll find all the truth.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在 YouTube 上搜，就能找到所有真相。

sentences.en: Then we talked about the videos on, I could debunk videos one by one, but I couldn't debunk the plot because he told me, like, there are so many videos like that.
sentences.zh: 后来我们聊到了那些视频，我可以逐一反驳视频内容，但我无法反驳那个阴谋，因为他告诉我，像这样的视频实在太多了。

sentences.en: It has to be true.
sentences.zh: 那一定是真的。

sentences.en: It was pretty intense because I knew the numbers.
sentences.zh: 当时情况相当紧张，因为我知道那些数据。

sentences.en: So I knew that this was not just one person.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道这不仅仅是一个人的问题。

sentences.en: This, it was millions of people who were in these situations.
sentences.zh: 这是数以百万计的人正处于这种境地。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Stefan Molyneux from Freedom Aid Radio.
sentences.zh: 我是来自“自由援助电台”的斯特凡·莫利纽克斯。

sentences.en: Let's dip into the Lister mailbag of questions.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看利斯特的听众来信。

sentences.en: Shall we try to see how far we can go back in the search?
sentences.zh: 我们要不要试着看看搜索记录能追溯到多远？

sentences.en: If we search history, like, down there.
sentences.zh: 如果我们搜索历史记录，就像在下面那样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You have the number one news network on cable.
sentences.zh: 你拥有有线电视上排名第一的新闻网络。

sentences.en: Yep, yep, yep.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错，没错。

sentences.en: I remember this.
sentences.zh: 我记得这个。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, now we're starting.
sentences.zh: 现在，现在我们开始了。

sentences.en: When you look at Hollywood, this is a Jewish cultural system designed to mark what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 当你审视好莱坞时，这是一个旨在标记你行为的犹太文化体系。

sentences.en: So, of course, the deep state, come on.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然了，深层政府，得了吧。

sentences.en: Why would I want my nation to be populated by and reflect the culture of people who have come from all other places in the world?
sentences.zh: 我为什么希望我的国家住满来自世界各地的人，并反映他们的文化？

sentences.en: To hear more, go to whatever app you're using to hear me right now.
sentences.zh: 想了解更多，请前往你现在收听我节目的任何应用程序。

sentences.en: Search for Rabbit Hole, two words, and hit subscribe.
sentences.zh: 搜索“Rabbit Hole”（兔子洞），两个词，然后点击订阅。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter 秀》节目，我们正准备迎接假期客人的到来。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter 秀》。
